name: Zoho Znote Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Select a ZIP with the file picker; the archive can sit outside the vault.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Zoho Znote Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
